units.source_text: 你的话真奇怪！”她谴责他，娇嗔之相亦甚可爱。

en.t: What a strange thing for you to say! she reproached him, and even her pouting anger was very charming.

units.source_text: 多年以来，夕雾为公主竭诚效劳，多方照拂，其忠实远胜他人，但此时已经前功尽弃。

en.t: For many years Yugiri had served the princess with all his heart and cared for her in every way, showing a devotion far beyond anyone else's, but now all of that had been thrown away.

units.source_text: 他此次忽然放肆，显露了好色的本相，致使公主受惊，自己亦觉可耻。

en.t: This time he had suddenly acted outrageously, revealing his lustful true nature, frightening the princess and making even himself feel ashamed.

units.source_text: 但仔细回想，又觉此次勉强遵从公主之意，未成事实，过后得不被人当作笑柄？

en.t: Yet when he thought it over carefully, he felt that since he had reluctantly yielded to the princess's wishes and nothing had actually happened, would he not later become a laughingstock?

units.source_text: 归途中左思右想，心绪烦乱，只赢得满身朝露。

en.t: On the way home he turned it over again and again, his thoughts in turmoil, and gained nothing but a body drenched in morning dew.
